whenUse: Perguntas frequentes em que cada questão expande sua resposta.
Configurações, planos, detalhes de produto ou etapas de integração organizados em seções expansíveis.
Listas de pessoas ou registros que revelam detalhes, como membros e permissões.
whenNotUse: Para apenas um painel que abre e fecha, prefira Collapsible.
Para uma seção completa de perguntas frequentes de uma página institucional, considere um bloco FAQ.
Para alternar entre diferentes visões do mesmo espaço, prefira Tabs.
agentNotes: Na variante Base UI, use multiple e defaultValue como lista de identificadores; na variante Radix, type controla expansão única ou múltipla e o defaultValue de modo único é uma string.
Conteúdos recolhidos podem não estar presentes no HTML entregue pelo servidor sem montagem persistente; não dependa deles para indexação ou conteúdo crítico.
Inclua título claro em cada AccordionTrigger e mantenha a hierarquia acessível de AccordionItem e AccordionContent.
Use disabled nos itens indisponíveis; estados aberto, fechado e desabilitado devem ser testados também por teclado.
Prefira expansão única para leitura sequencial e múltipla para comparar seções. Evite aninhar painéis sem necessidade.

Contrato JSON v2.1: items[].title, items[].content, items[].value opcional e items[].disabled opcional; type (single/multiple), collapsible, defaultValue, defaultValues, indicator (chevron/plus-minus/arrow-left) e appearance (plain/bordered/highlighted). São campos validados pelo Zod; não aceite estilos CSS arbitrários nem JSX gerado.
O indicador padrão vem de AccordionTrigger; esconda-o quando usar um indicador customizado, evitando duas setas simultâneas.
Os exemplos 9 e 11 são padrões compostos (avatares e onboarding); preserve a semântica e a navegação pelo teclado.
Para as variantes do ReUI com Avatar, Badge, Frame, campos de formulário ou QR code, use composições TSX previamente aprovadas; o contrato primitivo não aceita filhos JSX arbitrários.

Accordion aninhado com itens delimitados por bordas
Accordion de usuários com avatares e indicadores de função
Accordion com indicador de seta rotativa
Accordion para etapas de integração, com ícones, badges e código QR

whenUse: Inline status messages in the page for success, info, warning and error outcomes
Notices that offer a next step, such as a security update, a renewal reminder or a plan upgrade
Status rows set inside a Frame panel, such as service health, deploy results and message notifications
whenNotUse: A yes or no decision that must be answered before the page goes on: use Alert Dialog (getcomponent("alert-dialog"))
A brief confirmation that floats in a corner and disappears by itself: use Sonner (getcomponent("sonner"))
A complete modal task, such as a plan cancellation form that holds a warning banner: use the Dialog blocks
agentNotes: Every Alert sets role alert, an assertive live region; pass role status for a notice that is not urgent
AlertTitle carries a 1 line clamp by default, so copy longer than a heading goes in AlertDescription
Alert has no open state or close part, so a Dismiss button must unmount it from state you own

whenUse: Profile photos with initials or a user icon that stand in when the picture is missing or fails
Presence dots, verified marks and number badges pinned to the corners of a person's photo
Overlapping team stacks, social proof rows and user chips inside buttons or account triggers
whenNotUse: An account panel opened from a trigger, with the name, email and grouped actions: use Dropdown Menu (getcomponent("dropdown-menu"))
A full account settings page where a person edits photo, name and details: use the Profile blocks
A workspace members directory with roles, invites and access status: use the Users blocks
agentNotes: Initials inside AvatarFallback are typed by hand in every example; derive them from each person's name rather than copying the sample letters
A square Avatar needs the same radius on AvatarImage, AvatarFallback and its after pseudo element border, since all 3 default to round

whenUse: Status and severity labels in solid, light and outline tones for success, warning, info and errors
Counts and short tags such as an unread number or a New marker, sized to the text around them
Compact chips pairing a label with an icon, a dot, an avatar, a flag or a remove control, or acting as a link
whenNotUse: An action that saves, opens or submits a form when pressed: use Button (getcomponent("button"))
Helper text revealed when a control is hovered or focused: use Tooltip (getcomponent("tooltip"))
A finished KPI or profile tile with a trend or status chip as one detail: use the Card blocks
agentNotes: Import Badge from @/components/reui/badge; the shadcn Badge of the same name lacks size, radius and the success, info and warning variants
The default radius follows the style, square in lyra and sera and a pill in maia, luma and rhea; radius full gives a pill in every style

whenUse: Ações de páginas, formulários e diálogos, com hierarquia primária, secundária, contorno, fantasma, destrutiva ou estilo de link.
Controles somente com ícones, como pesquisar, copiar, abrir menu, fechar e alternar tema, sempre com nome acessível.
Ações com feedback de execução, carregamento, confirmação, contador, notificação ou atalho de teclado.
whenNotUse: Várias ações relacionadas e unidas em um conjunto: prefira Button Group.
Alternância persistente entre ligado e desligado: use Toggle.
Ação incorporada à borda de um campo de texto: use Input Group.
agentNotes: No Base UI, o Button assume type='button'; use type='submit' explicitamente para submissão de formulários.
Para navegação, renderize uma âncora semântica com render e nativeButton=false; nunca trate navegação como mero clique sem destino.
Marque ícones com data-icon='inline-start' ou 'inline-end' para que os espaçamentos internos sejam aplicados corretamente.
Botões apenas com ícone exigem aria-label; estado de carregamento deve impedir acionamentos repetidos.
Ações de copiar, alterar tema, expandir, menus e carregamento assíncrono exigem estado ou comportamento de composição; não são apenas propriedades cosméticas do Button.
Exemplos com redes sociais ou avatares são composições: não introduza JSX arbitrário nem URLs externas não autorizadas pelo contrato JSON.

Use os seis estilos oficiais (default, secondary, outline, ghost, destructive, link) e os oito tamanhos (default, xs, sm, lg, icon, icon-xs, icon-sm, icon-lg); prefira as primitivas oficiais a duplicar CSS.

whenUse: Toolbars of related actions joined into one strip, such as editor, media, zoom or export controls
Split buttons that pair a main action with a chevron menu of its variants, such as Save or Publish
Segmented pickers and filter bars that join buttons to selects, inputs, counters and status text
whenNotUse: Segmented choices whose pressed option screen readers must hear announced: use Toggle Group (getcomponent("toggle-group"))
A text field with an icon, prefix or action drawn inside its own border: use Input Group (getcomponent("input-group"))
A single standalone action, or actions spaced apart with no shared border: use Button (getcomponent("button"))
agentNotes: On the base twin only children with a data-slot join at the seams, while radix joins every child; wrap custom markup in ButtonGroupText
ButtonGroup sets role group but no name; pass aria-label so screen readers say what the set controls

whenUse: Titled sections with body copy and footer actions, such as a help notice or a sign in form
Image tiles with a photo above the copy or filling the tile under a dark text overlay
Dashboard widgets such as a KPI with a trend, a usage meter or a deployment or integration status
whenNotUse: A finished grid of KPI tiles, feature links or profile records ready to drop in: use the Card blocks
A KPI panel with a range filter, a segmented meter or an activity feed beneath it: use the Stats blocks
A preview that pops up over a link while the pointer rests on it: use Hover Card (getcomponent("hover-card"))
agentNotes: Each example caps Card with max-w-xs, max-w-sm or max-w-md; drop the cap when the card should fill a grid cell or column
size sm on Card tightens padding and gaps in every style; none of these examples sets it, so try it before padding overrides

whenUse: Photo galleries and featured slides shown one at a time, moved by swipe, arrow buttons or a timer
Rows or columns of cards with several in view, sized per breakpoint or peeking at the next one
Media viewers where a thumbnail strip or a row of dots tracks the current slide and jumps to any one
whenNotUse: A rotating set of customer testimonials with star ratings and avatars: use the Review blocks
A shop page pairing a photo gallery with a buy box and size and color pickers: use the Product Detail blocks
A storefront section of shop collections with hover browse buttons: use the Category Card blocks
agentNotes: Every slide is a picsum.photos placeholder built with Array.from; map your own images and alt text from a real array
Where CarouselPrevious and CarouselNext are placed, they sit 3rem outside the slides at either end, so leave room or move them through className
Carousel reacts only to ArrowLeft and ArrowRight, vertical ones included, and only while focus sits on a control inside it

whenUse: Consent and opt-in fields, such as accepting terms or turning on a feature
Lists where any number of options can be ticked, like notification channels or permissions
Selectable cards and tiles for modules, people or a saved payment card
whenNotUse: A choice where exactly 1 option of a set may be picked: use Radio Group (getcomponent("radio-group"))
An on or off setting that applies the moment it is flipped: use Switch (getcomponent("switch"))
A complete record entry page with many field types and a submit handler: use the Form blocks
agentNotes: No example passes a name to Checkbox, so a native submit sends none of these boxes; give each one a name inside a real form
The base twin sets the mixed state with the indeterminate prop; the radix twin passes checked as the string indeterminate
A mixed state draws the same CheckIcon as a ticked box, as the indicator has no minus icon; add one in Checkbox to show a dash

whenUse: Cards and panels that hold back secondary detail, such as order items, a usage breakdown or a profile
Optional settings, advanced form fields and single help answers kept closed until asked for
Nested navigation menus and file trees, built by placing one collapsible inside another
whenNotUse: Several stacked sections that open and close as one group, often one at a time: use Accordion (getcomponent("accordion"))
A large folder hierarchy that people move through and expand with arrow keys: use Tree (getcomponent("tree"))
A complete account or workspace configuration page of grouped switch rows: use the Settings blocks
agentNotes: The trigger's aria-expanded carries open state in both twins and stays scoped when collapsibles nest, so key chevrons and fills on it
A closed CollapsibleContent renders none of its children in either twin, so that text is missing from the server HTML
Base UI CollapsibleTrigger swaps its element through render and the Radix one through asChild; each reads only its own prop

whenUse: Short forms and settings that need an answer before the page continues
Long text such as terms, read in a scrolling body that can grow to nearly full screen
Reference overlays and notices, such as a keyboard shortcuts list or a session timeout
whenNotUse: A yes or no confirmation before a destructive action: use Alert Dialog (getcomponent("alert-dialog"))
Long forms or record details that slide in from the screen edge: use Sheet (getcomponent("sheet"))
Mobile panels that open from the bottom and close with a swipe: use Drawer (getcomponent("drawer"))
agentNotes: Compose the trigger through render on the base twin and asChild on the radix twin; the other one is silently ignored
DialogContent renders its own close button; pass showCloseButton as false to drop it

whenUse: Touch panels that slide in from a screen edge and close with a swipe
Mobile tasks with a scrolling body between a title and footer actions
whenNotUse: A desktop side panel opened by mouse or keyboard with no swipe gesture: use Sheet (getcomponent("sheet"))
A slide out mini bag with quantity steppers, subtotal and checkout: use the Shopping Cart blocks
A centered modal for a short form or a confirmation: use Dialog (getcomponent("dialog"))
agentNotes: Set the edge with swipeDirection down, up, left or right on the base twin and direction bottom, top, left or right on radix
The base Drawer draws no grab handle unless you pass showSwipeHandle; the radix one draws it on every bottom drawer
The footer Submit Button has no handler and leaves the drawer open, unlike the DrawerClose Cancel beside it

whenUse: Action and overflow menus on a button or a dots icon, such as edit, duplicate, share, export and delete
Account, workspace and create menus showing the signed in user, workspace switching and sign out
Toggles, exclusive choices and short lists, such as panel layout, theme, AI models or recent alerts
whenNotUse: Actions opened by right clicking or long pressing a surface, with no button to press: use Context Menu (getcomponent("context-menu"))
A whole top bar with search, alerts, switchers and the user dropdown already placed: use the Navbar blocks
The account settings page an avatar link opens, with identity, team and billing forms: use the Profile blocks
agentNotes: DropdownMenuLabel throws on the base twin unless it sits inside a DropdownMenuGroup or DropdownMenuRadioGroup
On the base twin run an item's action from onClick; onSelect is a Radix item event that Base UI never fires
Pass the trigger element through render on the base twin and as the asChild child on radix; the prop meant for the other twin does nothing

whenUse: Labeled text, email and search fields, plain or restyled as a pill, an underline or borderless
Native typed fields for passwords, phones, URLs, numbers, dates, times, files, colors and ranges
Field states and hints: disabled, required or optional marks, errors, character counts and password strength
whenNotUse: Icons, buttons, units or a prefix that sit inside the border of the box: use Input Group (getcomponent("input-group"))
International numbers chosen by country flag and formatted as the user types: use Phone Input (getcomponent("phone-input"))
A whole create or edit page that gathers many fields under one save action: use the Form blocks
agentNotes: The red invalid border comes from aria-invalid on Input in every style; FieldError only prints the message

whenUse: Numbered page links between previous and next controls under a list, a table or search results
Compact pagers of back and forward controls alone or beside a page count, for narrow spaces
Table footers pairing page controls with a rows per page select, a range count or a page jump field
whenNotUse: A records table that sorts and filters its rows and needs its pager built in: use Data Grid (getcomponent("data-grid"))
A whole table section with a title, toolbar, rows and a working pager: use the Base blocks
Page controls kept in local state that run click handlers, with no URL per page: use Button Group (getcomponent("button-group"))
agentNotes: PaginationLink renders its own anchor and takes neither render nor asChild; swap that anchor for your router link in your copy of the component
Every href is a hash placeholder and each page number, count and current page is typed in; derive them from your page state or URL

whenUse: Quick edits and settings opened from a button, such as layer dimensions, switches or a volume slider
Previews opened by a click, such as a person's bio card, a template image with actions or an AI feature pitch
Inline details and short guides, such as exact times behind a relative date or a stepped feature tour
whenNotUse: A full account page that edits a person's name, avatar, email, team and billing: use the Profile blocks
A full page of record fields, such as an invoice or a product, ending in a submit row: use the Form blocks
A task that must block the page and hold focus until the user answers: use Dialog (getcomponent("dialog"))
agentNotes: Compose PopoverTrigger through render on the base twin and asChild on the radix twin, as every example does; the other twin's prop does not compose
PopoverContent is w-72 in both twins whatever it holds; size it with a width class such as w-auto or w-64
The base PopoverTitle names the popup for screen readers; the radix one is a plain div, so give radix PopoverContent an aria-label

whenUse: Labeled bars that report how far an upload, a download or a workspace setup has got, as a percent
File transfer rows with time left, and setup checklists whose bar counts the steps done
Compact bars in dense list rows, and bars pinned to a set height or filled in a color of their own
whenNotUse: A drop zone or picker where people choose the documents and images to send: use File Upload (getcomponent("file-upload"))
Numbered steps the user can open or move between, each with its own panel: use Stepper (getcomponent("stepper"))
A wait of unknown length, where no share of the work done can be shown: use Spinner (getcomponent("spinner"))
agentNotes: ProgressLabel and ProgressValue exist in the base twin only; radix Progress drops its children, so print the label and percent beside it
Set bar height on the progress-track slot in base, as c-progress-2 does, and with a height class on Progress in radix, whose root is the track
Only a base ProgressLabel names the bar for screen readers; give every other bar, radix ones included, an aria-label naming the task

whenUse: Short single choice lists in forms and settings, such as density, visibility, role or release channel
Option tiles and divided card rows for shipping speed, contact method, language or a teammate
Checkout and plan steps that pick one saved payment method or one priced subscription tier
whenNotUse: A list where any number of the options can be ticked together: use Checkbox (getcomponent("checkbox"))
A whole modal step built around one choice, such as a template or a sync scope: use the Dialog blocks
A full plan table with billing period tabs and a feature list per tier: use the Pricing blocks
agentNotes: Every example seeds RadioGroup through defaultValue and reads nothing back; pass a controlled value and a change handler to act on the pick
No example sets a name on RadioGroup, so a native form post carries no choice; add one when the group lives in a form
Every RadioGroupItem id is a fixed string such as r1 or an option value; derive unique ids when a group can render twice on one page

whenUse: Form fields that pick one value from a short fixed list, such as a fruit, timezone, country or size
Pickers whose options carry a status dot, badge, avatar, flag, icon or one line description
Toolbar filters and property pickers, such as status, priority, access level or assignee
whenNotUse: A long list the user wants to search by typing part of a name: use Combobox (getcomponent("combobox"))
A plain form field that should open the phone or browser's own picker: use Native Select (getcomponent("native-select"))
Options nested in levels, such as a category and then its subcategories: use Cascader (getcomponent("cascader"))
agentNotes: Pass alignItemWithTrigger false on the base twin or position popper on radix to open the list below the trigger, not over it
With no children, base SelectValue prints a string value raw unless Select gets items; radix SelectValue mirrors the chosen SelectItem
Base SelectItem can take a whole object as value, matched to defaultValue by reference; radix values must be non-empty strings

whenUse: Thin rules between a heading and its body, or between the stacked rows of a list or a summary
Vertical rules between inline labels or side by side menu entries along one row
Labeled breaks with a short caption centered on the rule, like an or continue with line
whenNotUse: A trail of links from the current page back up to its parent pages: use Breadcrumb (getcomponent("breadcrumb"))
Step lines and named phase breaks in an agent run log or transcript: use Marker (getcomponent("marker"))
A list of rows each led by an avatar or icon, with text and an action: use Item (getcomponent("item"))
agentNotes: The base Separator renders role separator, while the radix twin defaults decorative to true and renders role none, hidden from screen readers
A vertical Separator takes its height from self-stretch, so it shows only in a flex row or grid unless given a height such as h-8

whenUse: Placeholders for avatars and user info, text paragraphs, forms and media cards while data loads
Loading states for data tables, dashboard stats, lists with row actions, profile pages and chat threads
whenNotUse: Sortable record tables that draw their own placeholder rows during a fetch: use Data Grid (getcomponent("data-grid"))
Menu links in an app navigation rail that are still being fetched: use Sidebar (getcomponent("sidebar"))
A wait whose result has no known shape, such as a file being processed: use Spinner (getcomponent("spinner"))
agentNotes: Skeleton has no size of its own, so every placeholder here sets its height and width by class; size yours to the content it stands in for
Skeleton is a bare div with no role or text, so screen readers hear nothing; set aria-busy on the region it fills while loading
The default radius of Skeleton follows the style, square in lyra and sera and rounded-2xl in luma and rhea; circles need rounded-full

whenUse: Settings tuned by dragging along a bounded scale, such as volume, opacity or color temperature
Ranges picked with 2 or more thumbs on a single track, laid out horizontally or vertically
Durations, storage sizes and scores read off tick marks, scale labels, a value bubble or an emoji
whenNotUse: A complete shop facet panel with brands, colors, sizes and a price range: use the Filter Sidebar blocks
A value typed straight into a box, such as an exact price, with no scale to drag: use Input (getcomponent("input"))
A read only bar that reports how far a task or upload has got: use Progress (getcomponent("progress"))
agentNotes: The base Slider draws a thumb per entry of an array value or defaultValue; a plain number gets 2 stacked thumbs and 2 tab stops
htmlFor on a Label reaches only the root div of the base Slider, not its thumb input; name the slider with aria-labelledby instead
Base onValueChange is typed as a number or a read only array, so narrow it with Array.isArray; the radix twin passes a number array

whenUse: Pending states inside buttons, status badges and search fields while a request runs
Loading views for a card or an empty panel, including blurred covers over content being refreshed
Inline notes such as checking, syncing or reconnecting, led by a small tinted spinner or bouncing dots
whenNotUse: Content of a known layout, held as muted placeholder shapes until it arrives: use Skeleton (getcomponent("skeleton"))
A wait where the share of work done is known, such as an upload percent: use Progress (getcomponent("progress"))
A save control that tracks its own pending and done states after a click: use Button (getcomponent("button"))
agentNotes: No example holds a pending flag and disabled is hardcoded where it appears; show the indicator and lock controls from your own request state

whenUse: Single on or off preferences beside a label, such as airplane mode, sign in security or an AI feature
Grouped notification, privacy and editor preferences in a card, a Frame panel or a dense list
Options with a supporting sentence set as clickable tiles, including a risky one that erases data
whenNotUse: A complete options page with account, security and notification sections ready to drop in: use the Settings blocks
A row of pressed buttons that picks a view, an alignment or a time range: use Toggle Group (getcomponent("toggle-group"))
A consent or terms box that is ticked and sent along with a form: use Checkbox (getcomponent("checkbox"))
agentNotes: Every Switch here is uncontrolled, seeded by defaultChecked or left off, and nothing reads a flip back; control it to save the setting
No example gives Switch a name, so a native form submit carries none of these values; add one when the switch sits inside a form

whenUse: Short lists of records such as invoices, orders, members, files or API keys, one per row
Rows that carry status badges, avatars, a totals footer or a menu of row actions
Label and value pairs describing one record, such as an employee profile or a server
whenNotUse: Rows the reader sorts, filters, pages or selects with checkboxes: use Data Grid (getcomponent("data-grid"))
A ready made records section with a title bar, toolbar filters and a pager: use the Base blocks
An account page where a person edits their avatar, name, email and regional settings: use the Profile blocks
agentNotes: Table wraps the table in its own overflow-x-auto div, and className lands on the inner table, never on that scroll wrapper
TableCell and TableHead are nowrap in every style, so a long value widens the table and scrolls it sideways instead of wrapping

whenUse: Account, password and settings forms split into panels so only one shows at a time
Side navigation inside a page, with sections stacked in a column beside the open panel
Views of one surface, such as dashboard sections, mail folders or visitor stats by period
whenNotUse: A finished account settings page with workspace, team and billing sections built in: use the Profile blocks
A metric card whose period switch redraws a plotted trend: use the Line Chart blocks
A project header with a breadcrumb on top and a row of sections with avatars below: use the Navbar blocks
agentNotes: Only the active TabsContent renders in either twin, so other panels ship no server HTML and lose typed values on a switch
Arrow keys only move focus across TabsTrigger items on the base twin, where Enter or Space selects; radix selects on focus

whenUse: Messages, feedback and other free text answers that run over several lines
Labeled long text fields with a hint under the box, an error state or a disabled state
Profile bios that count characters toward a limit and grow as the user types
whenNotUse: A comment or prompt box with buttons or a live count inside its border: use Input Group (getcomponent("input-group"))
A modal that asks for a note along with reasons to tick, such as a churn survey: use the Dialog blocks
A complete page of fields, such as a support ticket or a profile edit, saved together: use the Form blocks
agentNotes: Textarea grows with its text through field-sizing-content with no height cap, and Chromium ignores rows; set min-h and max-h classes
Only aria-invalid on Textarea turns its border red, in every style; a data-invalid flag on Field leaves the border as it was

whenUse: Editor formatting controls that stay pressed, such as bold, italic, underline and strikethrough
Reaction and save controls, such as like, retweet, share and bookmark, with or without a count
Media and app controls with an on and off state, such as mute, pin to sidebar or a notifications bell
whenNotUse: A one time action such as Save, Send or Delete that keeps no pressed state: use Button (getcomponent("button"))
Related actions joined edge to edge into one strip, such as playback or zoom controls: use Button Group (getcomponent("button-group"))
A set of options read as one value and crossed with arrow keys, such as text alignment: use Toggle Group (getcomponent("toggle-group"))
agentNotes: Pressed state lives inside each Toggle or a local useState and nothing saves it; read changes from onPressedChange to persist them
Every Toggle here is named by aria-label, which wins over its visible text for screen readers, so update both when relabelling

whenUse: Editor formatting and alignment controls kept as one set, such as bold, italic, underline or justify
View, column layout and theme switchers where the pressed item holds the current choice
Short option rows for a time range, status, sort order, billing period, channels or device settings
whenNotUse: Related actions such as export, zoom or playback joined in one strip with no pressed state: use Button Group (getcomponent("button-group"))
A single on or off control such as bookmark or mute that stands on its own: use Toggle (getcomponent("toggle"))
Labelled settings in a list, each flipped on or off beside its own text: use Switch (getcomponent("switch"))
agentNotes: The base twin picks one item unless multiple is set and always takes an array defaultValue; the radix twin needs type single or multiple
No example passes value to ToggleGroup or reads a change back, so the pick stays inside the group; control it to act on the choice
A second click on a pressed ToggleGroupItem releases it in both twins, so even a single choice group can end with nothing picked

whenUse: Short labels for buttons and icon only toolbar actions, with a keyboard shortcut where one exists
Help text on an info icon, a warning, a verified mark, a locked feature or a disabled button
Compact summaries behind a trigger, such as service status, notifications, file details or a person
whenNotUse: Content with links or buttons that keyboard users must be able to reach: use Popover (getcomponent("popover"))
A rich profile or page preview with a large photo, bio and dates: use Hover Card (getcomponent("hover-card"))
A status or count that stays readable without pointing at anything: use Badge (getcomponent("badge"))
agentNotes: Outside a TooltipProvider the base Tooltip opens after 600ms and inside one at once; the radix Tooltip throws without one
TooltipTrigger renders a button of its own, so a Button nested in it without render or radix asChild makes a button in a button
TooltipContent is portaled to the end of the body with no focus guards, so a link or button in it is not next in Tab order after its trigger

whenUse: Exibir avaliações numéricas ou por estrelas, incluindo valores parciais.
Coletar classificação em formulários quando a interação for acessível.
whenNotUse: Não usar estrelas como única representação de dados sem texto alternativo.
Evitar para métricas que não correspondam a avaliações.
agentNotes: Use a variante apenas de leitura quando a entrada não for necessária.
A escala e o valor devem ser explícitos, validados e limitados; não aceitar JSX arbitrário em JSON.
Para edição, use composições estáticas com controles por teclado.
